tasks.title: Memory evidence: bundles grounded only in MemoryPort facts and stored user_confirmed keys
tasks.goal: Rain and lunch EvidenceBundles build memory/habit evidence records from MemoryPort facts, with every record's provenance CLASS set by classifyFactSource(fact, storedUserConfirmedKeys): 'confirmed' only when the key is in the stored user_confirmed set, otherwise 'sample'/'demo_sample' (honestly labelled sample facts keep their evidence; existence is never gated on confirmation). Remove the plan.why.memoryFactsUsed overlay and any fallback that grounds plan memory against itself (home-vm overlays, app lunch/Directions fallbacks). Add the server/client knownFactKeys and confirmedFactKeys parity test.
tasks.out_of_scope: No live MemoryPort/XMemo calls; no core (src/core) changes; no change to the verifier's fail-closed semantics
checks: Provenance-class test: every MemoryPort fact used by the plan yields a record whose provenance is classifyFactSource(fact, storedUserConfirmedKeys). Negative test: a status 'confirmed' fact WITHOUT a stored key yields a record with provenance 'sample' (present, not absent), and any render labelled 'confirmed'/'You confirmed' for it fails verification. Positive test: after a stored confirmation, the same key yields provenance 'confirmed'. The G12 rain prep rows (5/20 min) and V5-LUNCH taste rows stay green throughout

No code path remains that overlays plan.why.memoryFactsUsed or grounds plan memory against the plan itself (static search plus review evidence); server/client parity suite rejects the same malicious outputs on both sides
Affected e2e (rain and lunch Why flows) green; golden: report the real total (18), add-only

checks: Audit report covers every rendered slot in the rain, lunch, and fuel/lunch V5 walkthroughs, captured from the RENDERED DOM during the e2e runs (data-source-ref attributes or VM capture of rendered text, not hand-written copy), resolved per slot (not per-card); pass bar 0 mismatches
